$comment: Gate B DRAFT rule object for RF-FIELD-004 — pending, NON-EXECUTABLE. Authored only from RF Clinical Rule Specification v1.2 §13.5 and the RF-FIELD-004 inventory entry. Mixed-source rule. Expresses kicking-domain separation and kicking-exposure MONITORING structure only: where kicking is part of the athlete's demand profile, reintroduce and record it separately for kicking leg, volume, intensity, technique/context, chaos, data quality, and immediate/next-day response. Population-specific mechanism or recurrence percentages cannot be generalized, and kicking is not universally ranked above sprinting or other demands. Kicking stays separate from running/sprinting; tolerance of one field domain clears no other. No kicking progression schedule, dosage, exercise selection, field plan, complete rehab plan, RTT, or RTS; safety precedence preserved; does not bypass RF-FIELD-001/002/003, RF-RECUR-001/002, RF-REHAB-001..006, RF-SEV-005, RF-DX-006, or RF-SAF-006. Not approved. Not wired into any runtime.
rule_title: Kicking exposure is a separately monitored sport-demand domain

input_contract.$comment: Activation and the exact kicking-exposure tracking fields taken verbatim from v1.2 §13.5. No kicking volume/intensity/technique/next-day thresholds or progression increments are introduced.

decision_contract.$comment: Kicking-domain separation and monitoring structure only. Kicking is tracked separately and may be reintroduced progressively, but this rule creates no progression schedule, dosage, or thresholds. Mechanism/recurrence percentages are reference-only and cannot be generalized; kicking is not universally ranked. Tolerance of one field domain clears no other. Safety precedence preserved.

notes: Mixed normative source; MUST. Dual/contextual permitted_use in the body: logic_with_uncertainty for domain separation; evidence_record_only for epidemiological percentages — the inventory/object record the primary permitted_use (logic_with_uncertainty) and the dual role is captured structurally in decision_contract (domain_separation_permitted_use / epidemiological_percentage_permitted_use). Architecture refs preserved per source: V3.1-12 (current capacity & capacity-to-demand gap), V3.1-13 (rehab prescription/scheduling/monitoring), V3.1-14 (tiered return / autonomy boundary). Evidence roles/grades preserved per source: QRF-001 (M1; reference only), QRF-026 (D2; reference only), QRF-039 (D3; reference only), QRF-043 (D3; reference only) — none may become kicking-progression authority or individual recurrence-prediction authority. Per §13.5 logic preserved exactly: where kicking is part of the athlete's demand profile, reintroduce and record it separately for kicking leg, volume, intensity, technique/context, chaos, data quality, and immediate/next-day response (the full source field list is preserved, not only volume/intensity/technique/next-day). Per §13.5 limits preserved exactly: population-specific mechanism or recurrence percentages cannot be generalized, and kicking is not universally ranked above sprinting or other demands. Kicking stays separate from running and sprinting (running/sprinting/higher-speed tolerance do not clear kicking, and kicking tolerance clears no other field domain — consistent with RF-RECUR-002 and §13.1). No kicking volume/intensity/technique/next-day-response thresholds or progression increments are invented — §13.5 defines none; kicking may be reintroduced progressively but this rule creates no progression schedule, dosage, exercise selection, field plan, complete rehab plan, RTT, or RTS, and kicking-domain tracking alone is neither progression authority nor readiness. Safety-state choice (read §13.5 exactly): §13.5 does NOT assign a closed V3.1 safety state, so safety_state_output is null and blocked_targets is empty, and the kicking-domain separation/monitoring structure is represented in decision_contract; no safety state was inferred by analogy (any structural-restriction block is owned by RF-SAF-006). It does not bypass RF-FIELD-001/002/003, RF-RECUR-001/002, RF-REHAB-001..006, RF-SEV-005, RF-DX-006, or RF-SAF-006, and does not override RF-SAF-006, RF-DX-006, RF-DX-008, RF-SEV-004, RF-SEV-005, RF-RECUR-001, RF-RECUR-002, RF-FIELD-001, RF-FIELD-002, or RF-FIELD-003; uncertainty is preserved when kicking-exposure history, volume, intensity, technique quality, next-day response, sport context, mechanism context, recurrence, schedule, monitoring, or concurrent-injury evidence is incomplete. Kicking domain rule, not a safety rule. No kicking-exposure or readiness engine is authored here (deferred to the later field, rehab, and readiness objects). Draft — approval_status remains pending.
